description: Tool-selection benchmark (online). Each utterance is sent once to a Gemini text model with Nexora's real tool declarations (tools.py) and system prompt (ada.py); the first function call must match `expected`. `acceptable` lists other tools that are also a correct choice.

what's the weather like in London right now
how hot is it across Sri Lanka today
give me the latest news from Sri Lanka
what time is it
how much RAM am I using and what is eating my CPU
remember that my sister's birthday is on 14 March
what did I tell you about my supervisor
search my uploaded documents for the refund policy
start a 25 minute focus session for writing my report
pause my focus session
open notepad
take a screenshot of my screen
what windows do I have open
stop controlling my computer immediately
show me a map of Kandy
run a full system diagnostic, something feels broken
every morning at 8 remind me to drink water
what do you know about how Nexora and SQLite are connected
first get the time, then show my system stats, then notify me with both
what would happen if I moved my Downloads folder to the Desktop, don't actually do it
